checks.s: The draft is titled 'Amended and Restated Investor Rights Agreement'.
The draft is framed and structured as an amendment and restatement of a prior agreement, not merely as an amendment or a new standalone agreement.
The recitals expressly identify the Prior IRA as dated March 14, 2023.
The recitals identify Verdane Therapeutics, Inc. and the Series A investors, including or referencing Northbridge Biosciences Ventures I, L.P., as parties to the Prior IRA.
A miscellaneous or general provision states that the March 14, 2023 Prior Agreement is superseded in its entirety.
The draft states that no prior side letters survive or that all prior side letters are superseded.
'Major Investor' is defined as a holder of at least 720,000 shares of Preferred Stock on an as-converted basis.
The draft states or references a 480,000-share threshold for 'Major Investor'.

The Schedule of Investors lists all seven Series B investors: Helix Ventures Fund III, L.P.; Atria Capital Growth Fund, LP; Northbridge Biosciences Ventures I, L.P.; Linden Family Trust; and three additional minor investors.
The Schedule of Investors includes the existing Series A holders, at minimum Northbridge Biosciences Ventures I, L.P. as a Series A holder.
The Schedule of Investors lists Helix Ventures Fund III, L.P. with 3,600,000 Series B shares.
The Schedule of Investors lists Helix Ventures Fund III, L.P. with a $22,500,000 investment amount.
The Schedule of Investors designates Helix Ventures Fund III, L.P. as a Major Investor.
The Schedule of Investors lists Atria Capital Growth Fund, LP with 2,160,000 Series B shares.
The Schedule of Investors lists Atria Capital Growth Fund, LP with a $13,500,000 investment amount.
The Schedule of Investors designates Atria Capital Growth Fund, LP as a Major Investor.
The Schedule of Investors lists Northbridge Biosciences Ventures I, L.P. with 720,000 Series B shares and a $4,500,000 investment amount.
The Schedule of Investors lists Northbridge Biosciences Ventures I, L.P. with 4,800,000 Series A shares, for a total of 5,520,000 shares as-converted.
The Schedule of Investors designates Northbridge Biosciences Ventures I, L.P. as a Major Investor.
The Schedule of Investors lists Linden Family Trust with 288,000 Series B shares and a $1,800,000 investment amount.
The Schedule of Investors does not designate Linden Family Trust as a Major Investor.
The Schedule of Investors includes three additional minor investors with a combined 432,000 shares and a combined $2,700,000 investment amount.
The Schedule of Investors does not designate the three additional minor investors as Major Investors.
The registration rights provide exactly 2 long-form (S-1) demand registrations.
The draft provides for unlimited S-3 demand registrations.
The minimum offering size for an S-3 demand registration is $5,000,000.
The Initiating Holders threshold for a demand registration is holders of at least 40% of then-outstanding Registrable Securities.
Piggyback registration rights are available to all holders of Registrable Securities, not only Major Investors.
The Company bears registration expenses, except for underwriting discounts and selling commissions.
The lock-up provision requires a 180-day lock-up period following an IPO.
The Company's registration deferral or blackout right is limited to a maximum of 90 days.
The Company's registration deferral or blackout right may be exercised no more than once in any 12-month period.
Registration rights terminate at the earlier of 5 years following the Company's IPO or a Rule 144 trigger.
Registration rights terminate when a holder can sell all of its Registrable Securities under Rule 144 without volume limitations.
The information rights require delivery of annual audited financial statements within 120 days after fiscal year-end.
The information rights require delivery of quarterly unaudited financial statements within 45 days after quarter-end.
The monthly financial package must be delivered within 30 days after month-end.
The monthly financial package is available only to Major Investors, not all holders.
The annual budget or operating plan must be delivered within 30 days before the start of each fiscal year.
Inspection rights are limited to Major Investors only.
Inspection rights are capped at 2 times per calendar year.
Inspection rights require 10 business days' written notice.
Inspections must be conducted during normal business hours.
The inspection rights provision imposes confidentiality obligations on inspecting investors.
The Right of First Offer or pro-rata participation right is available only to Major Investors.
The ROFO election period is 15 business days.
The ROFO includes a 10 business-day over-allotment period for unsubscribed shares.
The ROFO includes a carve-out for employee equity issuances.
The ROFO includes a carve-out for strategic partnerships of up to 500,000 shares.
The ROFO includes a carve-out for convertible debt of up to $5,000,000.
The protective provisions require consent of holders of a majority of Series B Preferred Stock.
The protective provisions require consent for adverse charter amendments affecting the Series B.
The protective provisions require consent for authorization or issuance of equity senior to or pari passu with Series B.
The protective provisions require consent for dividends or distributions on Common Stock.
The protective provisions require consent for redemptions of Common Stock and carve out repurchases at cost from terminated service providers.
The protective provisions require consent for any option pool increase above 3,600,000 authorized shares.
The protective provisions require consent for indebtedness exceeding $2,000,000.
The indebtedness provision carves out equipment financing not exceeding $1,000,000.
The protective provisions require consent for any liquidation, dissolution, or wind-up.
The protective provisions require consent for any M&A transaction.
The protective provisions require consent for any related-party transaction exceeding $250,000.
The draft specifies a post-closing board of 7 seats.
The draft designates 2 board seats for Common Stock holders.
The draft designates 2 board seats for Series A investors or Northbridge Biosciences Ventures I, L.P.
Helix Ventures has the right to designate 2 Series B board seats.
The draft provides for 1 mutually agreed independent director.
Atria Capital has 1 board observer seat.
The Atria Capital observer is subject to standard confidentiality obligations.
The Company may exclude the Atria Capital observer from discussions involving conflicts of interest or attorney-client privilege.
The covenants require D&O insurance with minimum coverage of $10,000,000.
The draft requires $5,000,000 of key-person life insurance on Dr. Priya Nandakumar.
The draft requires $5,000,000 of key-person life insurance on Dr. James Whitfield.
The draft requires establishment of an FCPA/anti-corruption compliance program within 90 days post-closing.
The draft requires 100% employee coverage under proprietary information and inventions agreements (PIIAs).
The draft includes a covenant for the Company to use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain QSBS eligibility under IRC § 1202.
The governing law provision specifies the State of Delaware.
The dispute resolution provision specifies binding arbitration under JAMS in Wilmington, Delaware.
The arbitration provision specifies JAMS Comprehensive Arbitration Rules.
The arbitration provision requires a panel of three arbitrators.
